meta.title: GuFeng Plugin
meta.description: Run sessions only during DeepSeek's idle hours: peak hours are Beijing time Monday to Friday 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 (Chinese statutory holidays excluded); everything else — lunch break, nights, weekends, and entire holidays — is idle time. The button shows the current phase (Peak / Idle) and a countdown to the next switch; click the top-right button to mark the current session as an idle session (selected = dark theme, unselected = light theme). During peak hours an idle-session agent is held, prompts you send meanwhile stay queued, and work resumes automatically once idle time begins.
